bug_semantics: For Servlet, an attacker-controlled Base64 REDIRECT_URI cookie was decoded into UriComponents and its scheme, host, port, path, and query became the SavedRequest redirect URL. For Reactive, the attacker-controlled cookie was decoded and converted directly with URI.create. Neither sink required a relative path, so a successful login could redirect the user to an attacker-controlled origin.
